degree_rationale: Three Malformations (places of deceit: water, darkness, fire) — how rulers were stripped naked of these places, like a wise physician stripping plagues from a sick body. Illumination of the cleansing mechanism by detailed analogy.
direction_rationale: South-turn at the spiritual: the mechanisms are now SHOWN by analogy — the physician, the child wearing many garments. Illumines HOW the cleansing works through extended likening.
grand_man_function: Spiritual purifying-illumination — the physician-analogy for cosmic medicine.
title: The Three Malformations: how the rulers were stripped and bound
